title: When to Choose a Breast Lift over Breast Augmentation

html:
When it comes to enhancing your breasts, it’s a very personal choice. There is no such thing as a one-size-fits-all solution that will work for every woman. You need to look at your personal appearance and think about what kind of changes you would like to see in your breasts before moving forward with any procedure. A breast lift and breast augmentation are two options that women have that provide different results. Consider both of your alternatives to help you make an informed decision about your body. You want to get it right the first time when you are having any surgical procedure.

When to Consider Breast Augmentation

Breast augmentation involves the insertion of breast implants to increase the size of your bust. If you are looking for a larger cup size that may also alter the shape of your breasts, this could be the best choice for you. You can choose the shape of your implants and the type of implant. Implants can be filled with silicone or saline. Another option that is increasing in popularity is fat transfer in which fat is harvested from your body and injected into your breasts to bring an increase of about one cup in size. For more significant boosts in size, you’ll want to choose breast implants.

When to Consider a Breast Lift

A breast lift is the best solution when you are dealing with sagging breasts. This often occurs after weight loss, pregnancy, or with aging. A breast lift sculpts breast tissue to give it a more youthful shape and lifts the breasts into a perkier position. You should choose this alternative if you are not concerned about the size of your breasts, only the way that your breasts droop.

Combining Procedures

If your breasts sag and you are not happy with the size of your breasts, you can opt for a combination of both procedures. The surgeon will insert implants and lift your breasts to provide you with optimal results to enhance your appearance.

What to Expect During Your Procedure

Regardless of which type of breast procedure you choose, you can expect an outpatient surgery in most cases. Intravenous sedation or anesthesia will be used. Incisions will be made in your breasts, beneath your breasts, or in the armpits, depending on your procedure. After your procedure is over, you will need to follow the surgeon’s advice to ensure an optimal recovery.

Learn More About Breast Procedure Options Today

If you are thinking about moving forward with a breast procedure, make sure you have all of the facts. Contact Hanemann Plastic Surgery today to schedule your appointment. You will be able to discuss your goals and have a treatment plan developed for you.
